description: This file contains the implementation of the AdoNetGrainDirectory class, which manages grain activation lookups, registration, unregistration, and silo management within Orleans using ADO.NET. It includes methods for querying and modifying grain activation data, along with detailed logging.

classes.name: AdoNetGrainDirectory
classes.description: A sealed partial class implementing IGrainDirectory, responsible for managing grain activation lifecycle and silo registration using ADO.NET within Orleans.

methods.name: Lookup
methods.description: Asynchronously looks up a grain activation by its GrainId, returning its address if found.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a new grain activation with the specified GrainAddress, returning the registered address.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a grain activation based on its GrainAddress.

methods.name: UnregisterSilos
methods.description: Unregisters all grain activations associated with a list of silo addresses.

methods.name: GetQueriesAsync
methods.description: Ensures the queries object is loaded asynchronously, with thread-safe lazy initialization.
